locations.note: In this VR prequel, the doctor Serdar searches Moscow's post-apocalyptic metro tunnels for his wife Yana and the medicine she needs.
In 2018 nosalises attack Polyanka, Serdar's home station, and he has to shut the station gate on his friends, trapping them inside with the monsters.
A decade later Serdar and Yana have settled in Akademicheskaya; he sets out from there after Yana storms off, and later comes back to find the station attacked by cultists.
Following Yana's trail to Tretyakovskaya, the station where her son Petya died, Serdar is knocked out and caught by slave traders; at the end he brings Petya back there to his mother.

routes.name: Serdar
routes.note: From the fall of Polyanka in 2018 to Serdar's home at Akademicheskaya, the slavers at Tretyakovskaya, back to the ravaged Akademicheskaya and on to Tretyakovskaya for the reunion.
